contexts.text: Buckler and target () = protection against falsities.
Buckler, etc. () are significative of the power of truth.
Buckler, arrows = truths of doctrine from the Word by means of which there is protection from the falsities of evil. References.
My buckler and the horn of my salvation () = salvation thence. Buckler is predicated of Divine good.
Buckler () = falsity destroying good; shield, falsity destroying truth.

A buckler (), because it defends the head, = protection against the falsities which destroy the understanding of truth; a shield, because it defends the breast, = protection against the falsities which destroy charity, which is the will of good.
